BiblicalUsage: Jekameam is an Israelite, a Levite of the house of Hebron. In 1 Chronicles 23:19, Jekameam the fourth. The fuller story is told on the Jekameam profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jekameam belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
